title: Add a minimum absolute Body-spacing / degenerate-length validation
description:
Source: docs/tasks/tickets/CC-079-minimum-body-spacing-validation.md
Source key: CC-079
Source status: Backlog
Source priority: P3

## Summary

The validator has no minimum absolute Body-sample spacing check, so two
degenerately close samples (or a zero-length body segment) pass validation and
can produce degenerate field geometry.

## Scope

- Add a report-only validation that flags Body samples closer than a documented
  absolute tolerance, or a degenerate (near-zero-length) body segment.
- Define the tolerance as a GenTolerance constant consistent with existing limb
  tolerances.
- Do not repair or auto-merge samples.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A definition with two nearly coincident Body samples reports a validation
  issue with a stable code.
- A normal dino fixture reports no false positives.
- The check is deterministic and independent of list order.

## Validation

- Validator PlayMode tests for the degenerate and normal cases.

## Findings

Raised as finding 2.4 in the 2026-08-24 audit addendum. Related to CC-054
(thickness-profile quantization) but distinct: this is about authored Body
sample positions, not curve keys.

## Blockers

None.

## Next Step

Confirm the tolerance value against the dino fixture, then add the check + tests.

comments.body:
Implementation (Round 2 subagent): report-only minimum absolute Body-spacing / degenerate-length check in DefinitionValidator.ValidateBody (CC-079 finding 2.4). Tolerance constant `GenerationTolerances.MinBodySegmentLength = 1e-3f` (mirrors MinLimbSegmentLength / the linear 1e-3 degenerate family). New stable code `ValidationCode.BodySamplesTooClose` (APPENDED at end of enum to preserve existing numeric codes). No repair, no merge, no canonicalization change. Design: pair-scan of unordered Body-sample pairs (< tol^2 via sqrMagnitude, report first pair once) so detection is order-independent and also catches a degenerate adjacent (near-zero-length) segment.

Files: GenerationTolerances.cs, ValidationCode.cs, DefinitionValidator.cs, DefinitionValidatorTests.cs.

Validation (Unity PlayMode, actually executed — editor 6000.0.35f1): DefinitionValidatorTests fixture 42/42 passed; new tests individually 1/1 each: Validate_DetectsNearlyCoincidentBodySamples, Validate_NormalBodySpline_NoFalsePositive, Validate_BodySamplesTooClose_IsDeterministicAndOrderIndependent. dotnet build Runtime + Tests.Runtime 0W/0E. git diff --check clean.
